reason: brace-expansion <=5.0.7 can be driven into unbounded expansion and an out-of-memory crash. Every installed path is a development-time tool expanding patterns from our own configuration rather than user input: eslint itself, and the eslint-plugin-import copy that arrives transitively through eslint-config-next. Nothing in the shipped bundle reaches it.
upstream: Blocked upstream: minimatch@^3.1.2 is pinned by eslint's own dependencies and by the eslint plugins eslint-config-next brings in, all already at their latest versions. npm's suggested remediation is eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y@6.4.1, a downgrade flagged semver-major, which is destructive rather than a fix.
